newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks dip on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks dip on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dipped on Wednesday's new accounts day amid bearish sentiment before the June 14 announcement of the 1997/98 (July-June) budget, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said.
They said selling of blue chips could push prices down further before the close.

The Karachi 100-share index dipped 6.94 points, or 0.46 percent, to 1,492.79 amid 73 losers and 19 gainers in the first hour of trade. Hub Power fell 0.45 rupee to 37.35 and ICI Pakistan 0.40 to 23.65 at 11.03 a.m. (0603 GMT).
